description: Storefront read side and cart. Products API + query helpers, shop grid and product detail with filter-by-dial-color / sort-by-price and out-of-stock handling, money formatting (kobo), and a client-side cart (React context + localStorage) with add/update-qty/remove, subtotal and item count, and a cart page. Browsing and cart require NO auth. Covers tasks.md tasks 5-6. Depends on FEAT-001 (and FEAT-002 for providers.tsx, which it extends).
steps: Create src/lib/money.ts: formatKobo(kobo:number) -> NGN string (e.g. '₦15,000.00'); koboToNaira helper.
Create src/lib/products.ts: listActiveProducts({dialColor?, sort?}) (where isActive true, optional dialColor filter, orderBy priceKobo asc/desc) and getProduct(id).
Create src/app/api/products/route.ts GET returning active products (POST admin branch is added in FEAT-005). Mark 'export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"'.

Build src/app/(shop)/shop/page.tsx server component: grid of ProductCard (next/image, name, dialColor, formatKobo price); filter by dialColor and sort by price via searchParams; 'export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"'.
Build src/app/(shop)/product/[id]/page.tsx: image(s), name, description, dialColor, formatted price, stock; add-to-cart control disabled and 'Out of stock' label when stock<=0.
Create src/components/product-card.tsx and any shop layout/nav in src/components/ (brand-themed, light surface for readability per design.md).

Create src/lib/cart-context.tsx ('use client'): CartProvider + useCart hook; items {productId,name,unitPriceKobo,imageUrl,quantity}; add/updateQty/remove/clear; derived subtotalKobo + itemCount; persist to localStorage with an SSR-safe hydration guard (no window access during render).
Mount CartProvider inside src/app/providers.tsx (nested with SessionProvider from FEAT-002).
Build src/app/(shop)/cart/page.tsx: line items with qty controls + remove, running subtotal and item count, 'Proceed to Checkout' link to /checkout.
Wire the add-to-cart buttons in product-card.tsx and the product detail page to useCart (disabled when out of stock).
acceptance_criteria: Shop page lists active products with image, name, dial color, and formatted price; supports dial-color filter and price sort via query params.
Product detail shows full info and disables add-to-cart when stock<=0.
Cart supports add, change quantity, remove; shows subtotal and item count; persists across reloads via localStorage; works with no auth.
'npx tsc --noEmit' and 'npx next lint' pass; 'npx next build' compiles shop, product, and cart routes without needing a live DB (dynamic rendering).

findings:
DONE. Verification: prisma generate OK, tsc --noEmit clean, next lint clean, next build succeeded. Routes: /api/products, /shop, /product/[id] are ƒ (dynamic, force-dynamic); /cart is static (pure client cart). Integration notes for later features:
- MONEY: `import { formatKobo, koboToNaira } from "@/lib/money"`. formatKobo(kobo) -> NGN currency string via Intl.NumberFormat('en-NG', currency NGN) e.g. 1500000 -> '₦15,000.00'. koboToNaira(kobo)=kobo/100. Reuse formatKobo for order summaries/admin.
- PRODUCT QUERIES: `import { listActiveProducts, getProduct, listActiveDialColors, type ProductSort, type ListProductsOptions } from "@/lib/products"`. listActiveProducts({dialColor?, sort?}) -> Product[] (where isActive true; optional exact dialColor filter; sort 'price-asc'|'price-desc' orders by priceKobo, otherwise newest by createdAt desc). getProduct(id) -> Product|null (findUnique, no isActive filter — callers that must hide inactive should check product.isActive, as the detail page does). listActiveDialColors() -> distinct dialColor strings for filter UIs.
- PRODUCTS API: GET /api/products returns { products } (active only); reads ?dialColor and ?sort=price-asc|price-desc. force-dynamic. The admin POST create branch is intentionally NOT added here (left for FEAT-005).
- CART CONTEXT: `import { CartProvider, useCart } from "@/lib/cart-context"` ('use client'). CartProvider is mounted in src/app/providers.tsx NESTED INSIDE the existing SessionProvider (SessionProvider > CartProvider > children). useCart() -> { items: CartItem[], itemCount, subtotalKobo, addItem, updateQty, removeItem, clear }. CartItem = {productId,name,unitPriceKobo,imageUrl,quantity}. Persists to localStorage key 'dawns-embrace-cart'. SSR-safe: starts [] on server+first client render, hydrates from storage in a mount effect (no window access during render), so no hydration mismatch. addItem({productId,name,unitPriceKobo,imageUrl,quantity?}) merges by productId (adds quantities); updateQty(productId, n<=0) removes the line; removeItem/clear as named. CHECKOUT (FEAT-004) should read useCart().items and call clear() after a successful order; the server must re-fetch prices/stock from the DB and NOT trust these client prices (design.md §5).
- COMPONENTS: src/components/product-card.tsx (ProductCard, server-safe, next/image fill, links to /product/[id], shows 'Out of stock' badge, embeds AddToCartButton). src/components/add-to-cart-button.tsx ('use client', AddToCartButton; disabled + 'Out of stock' label when stock<=0; brief 'Added ✓' feedback). src/components/shop-nav.tsx ('use client', ShopNav; live cart itemCount badge; links Home/Shop/Cart).
- SHOP ROUTE GROUP: src/app/(shop)/layout.tsx wraps shop pages in a light gray surface (bg-gray-50 text-gray-900) + <ShopNav/>. shop/page.tsx is an async server component (searchParams is a Promise in Next 15 — await it) with a GET <form> for dialColor + sort filters. product/[id]/page.tsx awaits params (Promise), 404s via notFound() when missing or !isActive, disables add-to-cart when stock<=0. cart/page.tsx is 'use client' using useCart with qty number inputs, remove buttons, subtotal/itemCount, and a 'Proceed to Checkout' Link to /checkout.
- next/image already allow-lists res.cloudinary.com in next.config.ts; seed placeholder imageUrls are local '/brand/*.jpg' which Image serves fine. If future product images use other remote hosts, add them to next.config remotePatterns.
- NOTE: Next 15 dynamic APIs — page `params` and `searchParams` are Promises and must be awaited (done in shop + product detail).
